observations.behavior: Adds SES-specific click-tracking metadata and URL normalization, including a new per-link companion metric, a redirect unwrapper, and redaction of recipient-specific tokens.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows SES to distinguish multiple anchors pointing to the same destination; the handler preserves the index and the actual destination rather than the wrapper. This supports accurate per-link attribution without double-counting or storing recipient tokens.

observations.behavior: Defines a constant for the SES link index tag and a function to resolve the actual destination, unwrapping the PostHog redirect wrapper.
observations.posthog_connection: Reconstructs the destination the recipient requested, not the wrapper, enabling correct attribution and avoiding unaggregatable, per-send wrapper values.

observations.behavior: Adds an optional instanceIdOverride field to the metric record, allowing the handler to supply a custom key instead of the standard one.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports the new per-link companion metric, which uses a different key than the standard email_link_clicked, preventing double-counting.
